answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slow-unlock kernel of trust: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and build a history of attested work before gaining full privileges, like a trellis that only supports weight once its vines mature. New identities start at dawn with minimal quota, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs real deposits and time while yielding almost nothing. Sybil accounts cannot borrow the reputation of established peers, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught attesting fraudulently, making mass forgery unprofitable.
